# Typography fixtures

These are unmodified upstream font bytes, retained for container, variation and representative Hebrew text tests. Both families use the SIL Open Font License 1.1; retain the complete adjacent license files when redistributing. No installed operating-system fonts or generated conversions are included.

Source Sans 3 comes from [release 3.052R](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/releases/tag/3.052R), commit `ed1808970eb3c7301c9a523bee26473ba0bb62fa`. Copyright 2010–2022 Adobe; reserved font name Source. See [SOURCE-SANS-LICENSE.md](SOURCE-SANS-LICENSE.md).

| SourceSans3-Regular.ttf.woff    | WOFF/TTF/SourceSans3-Regular.ttf.woff    | 56413337e96f5764882f3e18eaa654eec27515ec7c3de3520eec9e36b25371b9 |

Noto Sans Hebrew comes from [release NotoSansHebrew-v3.001](https://github.com/notofonts/hebrew/releases/tag/NotoSansHebrew-v3.001), commit `036f3206f67caac235cf8546a7751d3440771a7e`. Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors. See [NOTO-HEBREW-OFL.txt](NOTO-HEBREW-OFL.txt).

`NotoSansHebrew-Full-Regular.ttf` is the unchanged release member `NotoSansHebrew/full/ttf/NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf`; its filename distinguishes the full Latin/Hebrew character set. SHA256: `671951828bd5c95db818e5bb12dcea2d0c0dda00311888522be061ee6835125e`. The original release ZIP SHA256 is `df0a71814b4e63644cf40fcc4529111b61266b7a2dafbe95068b29a7520cc3cb`.

The variable face has a weight axis from 200 to 900. These samples cover regular static faces, variable weight and one Hebrew/Latin combination; they do not establish every script, italic synthesis or physical readability.
